[[File:Mobile_shield_generator.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A mobile shield generator mounted on a Mobile Defense Unit.]]
The '''mobile shield generator''' was a device mounted on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Mobile Defense Unit]]s. It covered a small area in an energy shield making it slightly less effective then conventional [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]], but nevertheless was effective in protecting areas where conventional generators were not practical.
